# 347 Awakening (347 Happy Life Happy World)

> Guided, English-speaking meditation retreats and classes at the Silver Temple (Wat Sri Suphan), Wua Lai Road, Chiang Mai Old City, Thailand. Taught by Master Kaie. Vipassana-based meditation and mindfulness combined with inner coaching. Beginner-friendly.

- Google Maps listing: "347 Happy life meditation retreat"
- Location: Srisuphan Temple (Wat Sri Suphan), Wua Lai Road, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand. About 15 minutes from Chiang Mai International Airport.
- Formats: 3-hour on-site experiences (from THB 1,500 / USD 47), 1-day journey (THB 7,000 / USD 219), 1–3 day retreats (THB 7,000–15,000 / USD 219–477), live online programs (from THB 800 / USD 27), private 1:1 mentoring, and Inner Circle membership.
- Language: English. No meditation experience needed. Guided retreats with periods of silent practice (not a 10-day silent course).
- Accommodation and meals are not included.
- Booking: WhatsApp +66 94 426 5297 or 347happylifehappyworld@gmail.com. Payment by cash or bank transfer. Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
